patterns.note: Content is presented in wide, centered blocks with generous vertical spacing, creating an airy and uncluttered page structure.
A horizontal scrolling section is used to showcase multiple app cards, allowing users to browse an ecosystem of products efficiently.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of dark grey/black text on white/light grey backgrounds dominates, with minimal use of accent colors.
A sticky header bar, containing the logo and primary navigation links, remains fixed at the top of the viewport during scroll.
A cookie consent modal is persistently fixed to the bottom-right corner of the viewport, independent of page scroll.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains visibility of the brand and navigation as the user scrolls down the page. Content sections are separated by significant vertical padding, contributing to a spacious and clean aesthetic. A horizontal scrolling container is utilized for displaying a series of app cards, providing an interactive way to explore multiple items. No scroll-triggered content animations or reveals are used; elements simply scroll into and out of view linearly, maintaining a straightforward user experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2.5-3x body) with lighter weight body text and small, uppercase labels for calls to action.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (small border-radius) on buttons and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced padding within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its starkly clean, almost minimalist white aesthetic, subtly enhanced by abstract background patterns that provide visual texture without distracting from the content. The primary focus on showcasing an ecosystem of applications through a dedicated horizontal scroll section is also a key characteristic.
